semantic_roundtrip.remaining_semantic_delta: The six derived anchors share the same finite horizon and target prefix in [0,1]. The empirical mean is an attaining comparator; its loss is the minimum value. T=0 gives attainment and zero loss without uniqueness. Positive-horizon uniqueness is an existing separately proved interface. Generic trace identities assert neither causality nor prediction feasibility, and signed regret may be negative. The two bounds use actual meanPredict, initial1/2 and strict-past means, at positive T. The refined term is1/4 plus the sum over range(T-1) of4/(real t+2). No IID expectation/minimum interchange, ordinary regret limit, nonnegative excess-risk or chapter/book completion follows. Four missing-byte uses for two historical digests retain their original owners and OPEN statuses.
